description:
Convert between Unix epoch seconds/milliseconds and ISO 8601. Pass a number to convert to ISO, or an ISO string to convert to epoch.

Returns: JSON with ISO string, epoch seconds, epoch milliseconds, and a UTC-formatted representation.
Example input: {"value":"1700000000"}
On error, includes hint: `value` is a string: either an integer (seconds or ms since epoch) or an ISO 8601 timestamp.

value.description: A number (as string) or an ISO 8601 date string.

name: epoch_convert
title: Convert epoch time
